evidence_quote: This research is a quantitative research using survey method. The survey was carried out by giving a questionnaire to the research object.
The questions of questionnaire refer to the guideline for the EnMS implementation published by UNIDO where there are 9 questions related to variables that influence the EnMS implementation [13].

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper surveys the sustainability of EnMS implementation; it does not identify or characterise an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The research object consisted of 28 industries from 1 glass and ceramic sector, 16 textile and garment sector, 2 pulp and paper sector, 3 food and beverage sector, and 6 chemical sector.

stage1.notes: EnPI and baseline appear only as questionnaire items; no measurement model is characterised.
